title: Cloud quality tiers render as undefined in the prompt box

reason: Carded from MPI-852: the QUALITY radio prints the word `undefined` on every cloud model, because QUALITY_LABELS is a hardcoded id->label map that MPI-850/851's new tier ids (480p/720p/1080p, 1.5k) never reached. Fabio asked for it in a fresh session. plan.md carries the diagnosis and the file:line evidence.
